But the `ChartAlternatives` component and the parent that renders it in view mode are not shown. I can't confirm the gallery actually renders there instead of only in the edit-mode filters. The claim that it falls back to `ChartFilter` is only the author's.

Whether the dropdown is swapped out for the gallery depends on the `ChartAlternatives` component's branching on `canShowAlternatives`, which isn't shown. The logic change alone doesn't prove the dropdown stops rendering in view mode.

Edit mode previously required `editMode`, `!embedded`, `!inSharedMode`, `!isInDashboardContext`, `canEditInsight` and `!editingDisabledReason`. After the patch the remaining conditions are `!embedded && !inSharedMode && !isInDashboardContext && canEditInsight && !editingDisabledReason`. All still hold in edit mode, and the options, listeners and actions are untouched.

`selectChart` and `canSelectCharts = canShowAlternatives && !insightDataLoading` are shared between modes, so selection should work in view mode. The `selectChart` listener body isn't shown, and neither is whether the query change persists or is gated by edit mode.

The selector still requires `!embedded && !inSharedMode && !isInDashboardContext && canEditInsight && !editingDisabledReason`. `canShowAlternatives` still depends on `isEditableSurface`, so embedded, dashboard, shared and no-permission surfaces stay hidden.

`canShowAlternatives` is unchanged: `!!featureFlags[FEATURE_FLAGS.PRODUCT_ANALYTICS_CHART_ALTERNATIVES] && isEditableSurface && isTrends && !!query && !!trendsSource`. The flag, trends-only and query-shape gating apply regardless of mode.

`openGallery`, `closeGallery` and `toggleGallery` are mode-independent in the logic. The popover anchoring lives in the `ChartAlternatives` component, which isn't shown, so I can't confirm it in view mode.

result:
The chart type gallery now shows in view mode on a saved trends insight, so viewers get the same picker as in edit mode. I haven't run any tests or the type checker.

The cause was in `chartAlternativesLogic.ts`. The `isEditableSurface` selector required `editMode` to be true, so `canShowAlternatives` was false in view mode and `ChartAlternatives` fell back to the plain `ChartFilter` dropdown. I removed that `editMode` requirement, including its argument in the typegen'd selector type.

The other conditions still apply, so the gallery stays hidden on embedded, shared and dashboard surfaces. It also stays hidden when the user can't edit the insight or edits are disabled by overrides. The feature flag and the trends-only check are unchanged. Edit mode behaves as before.

Because the gallery replaces the dropdown wherever it shows, picking a chart in view mode changes the query the same way it does in edit mode.

I added a test in `ChartAlternatives.test.tsx` that renders the control without `editMode` and checks the gallery trigger appears.
